title: TY2027 ACTC total claiming returns
question: What will IRS SOI Publication 1304, Table 3.3, first report as the total number of returns claiming the additional child tax credit for tax year 2027, expressed in millions, conditional on the registered current-law threshold?
resolutionSource: IRS SOI Individual Income Tax Returns Complete Report, Publication 1304, Table 3.3
resolutionRule: Use the first official print of Publication 1304 Table 3.3 for tax year 2027: the all-returns total number of returns at the plain Additional child tax credit concept header, or its equivalent refundable child tax credit total header. Exclude the separate refundable-portion and used-to-offset-other-taxes subsets. Multiply the published return count by 0.000001 once to express millions, preserving published precision. Ignore subsequent revisions. Apply the registered condition. The resolution date is retained from the target contract but was not verified against an official release schedule in this run.
